title: The Quiet Reader
author: A. N. Story
description: A gentle novel about community, memory, and why books matter. The Quiet Reader follows a small-town library and the people who keep it alive.

title: Maps for the Unfamiliar
author: E. K. Lane
description: A collection of essays exploring belonging, travel, and the small rituals that make life feel navigable.

title: Tiny Lights
author: M. R. Coleman
description: A moving debut novel about family, art, and the small decisions that change the course of our lives.

title: The Pocket Guide to Backyard Birding
author: H. S. Patel
description: Practical, friendly, and perfect for new birdwatchers — this pocket guide helps you identify and attract birds to your yard.

title: Moonlight & Paperclips
author: Rhea Sol
description: A playful illustrated storybook for children about making things, fixing mistakes, and the magic of imagination.

title: Reading Lists for Rainy Days
author: Curator Collective
description: A themed reading list collection including recommendations and short guides to pair books by mood and season.
